place.name: Halle Gate
place.description: The Halle Gate (French: Porte de Hal, pronounced [pɔʁt də al]; Dutch: Hallepoort; Brusselian: Allepout) is a former medieval city gate and the last vestige of the second walls of Brussels, Belgium. Built in the 14th century, it was heavily restored in the 19th century in its current neo-Gothic style by the architect Henri Beyaert.
